entries.title: Seafoam Arched Interior Door Kit
entries.description: Original S01 independent frame and true arched leaf for the unchanged 1.4 m dining architecture family. Place kit jamb-foot origin at dining-archway-wall-01 origin +(0,0,0.05)m, or Z=0.095m above the bottom of dining-plank-floor-01. Frame outer/inner arch radii 0.412/0.386m, 0.232m deep, spring centre Z=1.60m; leaf radius0.372m, thickness0.036m, bottom clearance0.014m. DoorPivot (-0.380,-0.130,0)m is independently editable, opening towards -Y. Only discrete 0,-45,-90 degree Z poses are tested. No animation or continuous sweep claim. Keep old wall, maple reveals and threshold intact. Static central mounting shims deliberately engage the wall. One useful kit with editable frame, leaf, hinge and handle components; solid PBR materials, no textures. Functional origin is not the bounds centre.

entries.title: Passenger Waiting Station Scene
entries.description: Static passenger waiting station scene using five unchanged original asset IDs: open-front shelter, legacy harbor bench, information pole, straight pavement and dropped curb. Original seated shelter bay, separate standing bay, front through-space and offset boarding transition retain editable source nodes and actual support. Ramp retains 15mm lip. One scene, zero new models. No service, navigation, accessibility, load, stability or facility certification. See generator documentation and static layout evidence.

entries.title: Mature Open-Bough Conifer
entries.description: Original S02 hard-edge faceted mature conifer with a thick tapered central trunk, five unequal root flares, staggered spreading lower boughs, ascending upper boughs and narrow pointed leader. Individual angular needle masses follow visible supporting branches; crown gaps and unequal lengths make an independently authored mature silhouette. Ground interface is Z=0 at the trunk centre; roots spread beyond the stem. Named editable trunk, roots, primary branches, secondary forks and foliage components. Solid PBR materials, no external textures. Static visual prop with no wind rig, animation, collision mesh or continuous mechanical simulation. Not a scaled or recoloured young-conifer variant.

entries.title: S01 Right-Angle Pavement and Curb
entries.description: Original single closed 1.2 m square, 0.15 m high pavement corner with a continuous 0.15 m wide south/east curb band. West port X=-0.6 and north port Y=+0.6 join unchanged transport-curb-straight-01 or transport-curb-ramp-01. At identity, neighbours are centred (-1.6,0,0) with Z rotation 0 degrees and (0,1.6,0) with Z rotation +90 degrees. Rotate all placements together in 90-degree steps. Origin is footprint centre at ground Z=0. The old pieces retain their own 2 m pitch. One editable original mesh, two exact existing mineral PBR materials; no overlay or overlapping straight pieces. Static game visual module only; no road, engineering, accessibility, load or motion certification.

entries.title: S01 Seafoam Refrigerator Exterior
entries.description: Original freestanding static double-door refrigerator exterior in the S01 seafoam and warm-ivory interior family. Overall width 0.70 m, depth 0.70 m including handles and rear detail, height 1.80 m; front -Y and ground-contact origin Z=0. A smaller upper freezer face and larger lower refrigerator face have modeled perimeter seals, a visible horizontal seam, fixed two-point handles, a recessed kick grille, shallow rear service-panel detail and four feet. Independently editable closed exterior components. Use as a complete standalone kitchen appliance with placement gaps; not a fitted 0.60 m cabinet module. Static exterior only: doors are solid decorative faces, with no interior cavity, hinges, opening states, animation, refrigeration, installation or load claim.

entries.title: Dryland Bent-Blade Grass Clump
entries.description: Original S02 hard-edge faceted dryland grass tussock: twenty-four slender folded blades form three unequal grounded leaf fans, with an upright central crown and lower outward-bending secondary crowns. Each narrow blade has a shaped midrib, closed thin volume, varied arch and single tapering tip. Olive new growth and ochre older outer leaves support the low dryland silhouette without seed stems, reed culms or a soil pedestal. Metre scale, ground origin Z=0; named editable leaves and basal crowns. Solid PBR, no external textures, wind rig, animation or collision mesh. Independently authored geometry, not a scaled or recoloured wetland grass variant.

entries.title: S01 Wide Open Bookcase
entries.description: Original S01 freestanding wide shallow bookcase with four open horizontal book rows. Overall width 1.12 m, depth 0.34 m and height 1.80 m; metres, front -Y and ground-contact origin Z=0. Three fixed full-width intermediate shelves and the lower deck provide four long book surfaces, framed by warm-ivory side walls and crown, with a recessed seafoam backboard, two rear battens and a broad inset floor plinth. Each shelf has a nominal 0.98 m wide by 0.27 m deep flat placement rectangle; clear row heights exceed 0.35 m. Named closed components remain separately editable. Empty bookcase only, no books or props are included. Static visual furniture; no adjustable shelving, moving parts, book-fit validation, installation, load or tip-resistance certification.

entries.title: Narrow-to-Wide Stream Transition
entries.description: Original S02 two-port stream-width transition over a 2 m run, with channel bank-foot spacing changing from .60 to 1.40 m. End planes X=-1 and +1; tangent X; fixed water top Z=.16 m and zero longitudinal slope. Independent water body widens from .72 to 1.52 m, with .06 m lateral bank penetration matching the original straight-scene water style. Water top edges remain on the ports, but bottom edges retreat .01 m to make slanted closed caps without overlapping bank end faces; paired bottoms have a V gap and only surface continuity is claimed. Bank relative cross-sections preserve the original .06/.20/.55 m profile with +.09 m placement offset. Independently editable bed, banks, water and four inset original faceted rocks. Bed top Z=.09 m meets bank and water bottoms without overlapping end caps; bed extends .02 m past each outer bank. Legacy earth and water PBR values retained at end surfaces. Original bend raw water width is .60 m, so exact bend-water seam and whole legacy-scene base snapping are not claimed. Static visual module only; no hydrology, collision, navigation, walkability or physics certification.

entries.title: Open Seafoam Serving Pitcher
entries.description: Original S01 table-scale serving pitcher with a generous faceted belly, narrowed neck, large open refill mouth and an elongated integrated pouring lip. One continuous closed thick shell includes the flat base, real inner floor, inner walls and visible ivory rim. One separate solid C-profile rear handle has a large real aperture and two roots inserted into the body wall. Two named editable meshes, solid PBR materials, metre scale and body-base-centre origin at Z=0; spout +X, handle -X. Static game visual only; no liquid, pouring animation, capacity, load, grip ergonomics or food-contact certification.

entries.title: Low-Crown Pinnate Fern
entries.description: Original S02 hard-edge faceted fern with seven unequal arching fronds and a small grounded crown. Each continuous central rachis carries six pairs of separate folded lanceolate pinnae and a terminal leaflet; open pinna gaps form a feathered silhouette distinct from unsegmented grass blades. Five mature outward-bowing fronds and two shorter ascending inner fronds create a low asymmetric clump. Named editable closed-volume parts, solid PBR materials, metre scale and crown-centre ground origin Z=0. Independently authored static visual prop: no external textures, wind rig, animation, collision mesh, physics or species-accuracy guarantee.

entries.title: S01 Fixed Entryway Floor Mirror
entries.description: Original S01 fixed full-length entryway mirror, width 0.64 m, depth 0.34 m and height 1.68 m. A continuous 60 mm-deep clipped-corner maple ring retains a separate 7 mm mirror sheet and an 18 mm seafoam backboard. Two fixed rear supports join the lower ring and backboard to a broad ivory floor base. Metres, Z up, front -Y, origin at the floor-contact centre. Six named closed independently editable static components. The mirror uses standard metallic-roughness PBR, metallic 1 and roughness 0.12; no runtime planar reflection, environment capture or reflection-fidelity guarantee. No pivot, animation, decorative props, wall installation, load, stability, glass-safety or manufacturing certification.

entries.title: Eight-Slot Empty Dish Drying Rack
entries.description: Original S01 empty countertop dish rack: nine continuous rounded ivory dividers make eight vertical slots with measured 35 mm clear spacing. Three 14 mm wide bottom bearing strips have a 71 mm top support plane; the open spaces between them expose a separate shallow seafoam catch tray below. Four grounded broad foot-posts, low fixed frame and two maple-colored end loops complete one editable static rack. Metres, bottom-centre origin, slot repeat along X. No dishes, moving tray, water flow, load rating, stability certification, capacity, dynamic insertion or existing-tableware compatibility claim.

entries.title: S01 Compact Two-Seat Sofa
entries.description: Original S01 standalone two-seat living-room sofa, 1.68 m wide, 0.88 m deep and 0.92 m high. Metres, front -Y and ground-contact origin Z=0. Two broad seafoam seat pads and two rear-leaning back cushions have separate modeled seams. Low upholstered arms enclose the seats; an inset dark-seafoam deck and rear shell connect to a narrow honey-maple base rail and four short tapered feet. The stepped front cushion, deck, rail and feet remain legible. Named closed components are independently editable in native source and GLB. One complete independent sofa, not a sectional snap system. Static visual furniture only; no animation, upholstery simulation, ergonomic, installation, load, tip-resistance or cross-asset compatibility certification.

entries.title: Ochre Single Wedge Wheel Chock
entries.description: Original S01/S06 static single wheel-chock prop: an ochre rising wedge has a real transverse X-through gripping aperture in its thick rear section; a separate dark continuous sole has seven shallow underside channels and eight finite flat bearing strips. Two named editable closed meshes, solid PBR materials, metre scale and source Z-up. Origin X=Y=Z=0 lies on the ground, centred across width; sole Y extents -0.170 to +0.160 m. Low tip faces -Y, rising wedge and grip face +Y. One reusable model; repeated placements do not add models. Existing delivery-van wheel dimensions are a separate fixed-size visual comparison only. No vehicle-fit, braking, anti-roll, friction, load, carrying ergonomics, physics or safety certification.

entries.title: One-Metre Railway Infill Track
entries.description: Original one-metre railway half-length infill with two unscaled full-size timber sleepers and newly authored short rail stock. Y ports at plus/minus .50 m; clear head gauge 1.00 m, rail centres X plus/minus .54 m, head top Z=.20 m and sleeper pitch .50 m match the original 2m straight. Separate editable feet, webs, heads and sleepers; identity transforms, metres, Z up, underside-centre origin. Original 4mm head/foot end bevel and 8mm web retreat are retained: inset caps match, but paired running faces have a bevel notch and paired webs a 16mm gap. The original straight three-colour PBR palette is preserved. Intended for odd-metre static platform/turnout layout infill; no continuous train passage, wheel motion, load, engineering or railway safety certification.

entries.title: Root-Flared Broken Stump
entries.description: Original S02 hard-edge faceted standing tree stump. Five unequal buttress root flares flow into an offset tapered trunk in one continuous closed mesh. An irregular broken bark rim and angled exposed sapwood surround a solid eccentric heartwood section, with two subtle annual bands and a modeled radial V fissure. Metres, trunk-centre ground origin Z=0, named editable continuous mesh and solid untextured PBR. Original geometry, not a stripped anvil base or a rotated fallen log. Static natural ground dressing only; no decorative axe, mushrooms, collision mesh, physics, wind rig, animation or species-accuracy guarantee.

entries.title: Fitted Loading Platform End Ramp
entries.description: Original 1.4 m nominal-pitch end ramp for the existing 0.38 m loading platform. Metres, Z up, ground datum origin, uphill +X and rear curb +Y. Place the unchanged transport-short-platform-01 at (+1.4,0,0), no rotation. A low tapered toe and inclined cream deck rise to an upper landing; two grounded seafoam supports carry the deck and a honey rear curb follows the slope. The 25 mm high-end tongue fits the actual platform deck bevel; a 15 mm curb tongue meets its rear-curb bevel. The 1.425 m full X envelope includes the tongue and is not the nominal pitch. Full depth is 1.2 m. Static visual connector only; no accessibility, driving, collision, navigation, load, installation, safety or engineering certification. Not compatible with 2 m pavement modules or the 0.12/0.72 m launch ramp. No external model is embedded in this asset.

entries.title: Compact Parked Cargo Trailer
entries.description: Original S01/S06 static compact cargo trailer with one continuous open tub, a low supporting chassis, converging A-shaped drawbar, real vertical through-bored towing eye, two independently editable flat-tread tyre/hub assemblies, two raised mudguards with fixed brackets, and a grounded fixed parking leg. Four solid PBR materials, metre scale, source Z up, tow direction -Y. Ground origin is under the cargo tub centre; eye centre (0,-1.90,0.50) m with a 90 mm minimum clear bore along Z. Existing delivery van has no mating hitch; no host compatibility is claimed. One original reusable static prop, with no cargo or towing vehicle. No towing, animation, turning path, loading, braking, roadworthiness, stability, engineering, physics or safety certification.

entries.title: Bank-to-Plateau Escarpment Transition
entries.description: Original S02 steep bank-to-plateau terrain transition with two unequal cliff ledges, angular fracture facets, low earth apron and broad upper earth shoulder. One continuous closed editable mesh, 2 m X repeat, 1.60 m landward depth and approximately 1.70 m total height. At placement (0,1.2,0), the complete local Y=0 front cap matches the original straight bank landward boundary, including its .55/.58/.55 m rim at X=-1/0/+1. Full boundary agreement and finite opposed contact are verified for this one placement within 2e-6 m positional tolerance. X=-1 and +1 sections repeat with another copy translated 2 m along X. Legacy earth PBR is retained on the low apron; stone values follow coherent cliff planes. Local origin is the low-front boundary centre at ground Z=0. No water geometry, whole-scene or curved-bank snapping, walkability, navigation, collision mesh, dynamic terrain, physics or engineering certification.

entries.title: Single-space Parking Meter
entries.description: Original S01 static single-space parking-meter prop with a faceted arch-top head, a genuinely recessed analog-display pocket with fixed gauge marks and pointer, a deep closed-back coin-slot recess, and a fixed winding handle. The continuous post sits inside a socket on a flat ground plate with four static bolt heads. Metre scale, source Z up, operator face -Y, root at the ground under the post. Five solid PBR materials, no textures. Independent editable closed components. Existing cycle-service post and bus-stop information pole contain no parking timer; this is an original transport-expansion prop. No operating timer, animation, coin handling, payment, billing, parking enforcement, security, stability, engineering or infrastructure certification.

entries.title: Compact Railway Hopper Wagon
entries.description: Original static railway hopper wagon with one continuous thick open shell: a wide upper mouth, four inward-sloping interior walls and a true bottom-discharge throat. One fixed partly withdrawn steel gate leaves a visible clear opening; two guide rails and four slope-matched brackets attach it to an open underframe. Four independently editable flat steel treads, inner flanges and hubs use two fixed transverse axles. Metres, source Z up, long axis Y; flange-bottom origin. Tread centres X plus/minus .54 m, Y plus/minus .76 m, local tread bottom Z=.04 m. Place at Z=.16 m on the original 1.00 m clear-gauge straight track with head top Z=.20 m. The body is newly authored, not a reskinned flatbed. Three solid PBR materials and editable static components. No moving gate, bulk-material unloading, animation, continuous wheel motion, dynamic coupling, load, stability, physics, railway operations, engineering or safety certification.

entries.title: Stream Waterfall Height Transition
entries.description: Original S02 static stream waterfall transition with a real 1.10 m water-level drop over a 2 m X run. One continuous closed editable terrain solid surrounds a separate connected closed water body with an upstream lip, steep falling face and widened receiving basin. Both end sections match the existing stream-width transition narrow port: bank-foot spacing .60 m, raw water width .72 m; downstream X=+1 water Z=.16 m, upstream X=-1 water Z=1.26 m. Old upstream placement is rotation Z=180 degrees plus translation (-2,0,1.10) m; downstream translation (2,0,0) m. Terrain union caps match within 2e-6 m. Water bottom edges retreat .01 m, retaining the old 20 mm paired V gap: water-surface continuity only, no full water-volume claim. Legacy earth/water PBR values remain on visible port-adjacent surfaces; hidden terrain cap material partition is not identical to the old separate bed/bank caps. Upper-end installation requires equally raised supporting terrain. The escarpment is a height-scale reference only; no cliff-side, bend or whole-scene exact snap. No added decorative rocks or vegetation. Static visual module only; no animated flow, hydrology, collision, navigation, walkability, support/load or physics certification.

entries.title: Open-window Passenger Minibus
entries.description: Original S01 static short passenger minibus with a genuine hollow cabin, three paired passenger seat rows, separate driver seat and fixed steering visual, open window apertures, right-front entry and integral two-tread fixed stair. Every seat pedestal joins the floor; four flat-facet tyres join fixed hubs, axles and chassis. Metre scale, source Z up, front -Y, ground origin under the body centre. Five solid PBR materials and named editable closed components. Window apertures are intentionally open with no glass or opaque glazing. One parked visual prop, without door leaf, animation, driving, passenger capacity certification, navigation, collision, roadworthiness, accessibility, load, engineering, physics or exact station compatibility claims.

entries.title: Open Understory Forest Path Scene
entries.description: Static forest-path scene: sixteen unit-scale instances from six fixed existing assets, with original geometry and solid PBR preserved. Four soil-road modules retain 2mm seams and shallow ruts. Two broadleaf trees, two young conifers, three shrubs, three ferns and two scree clusters form low foreground, clear path and rear canopy layers. One new scene-only closed forest-floor support has bottom Z0 and top .16m; source ground interfaces sit at .16m. One scene, zero new standalone models. Editable original-ID hierarchy; no collision, navigation, animation or safety certification.
